task.description: GH #567 / ISS-0618: two failures in tests/integration/sch02_timer_polling_test.zig. (1) TC-SCH-02-02 ('scheduler skips locked timers and does not fire CANCELLED timers') asserts skipped_locked > 0 but gets 0. (2) TC-SCH-02-03 ('firing rollback keeps timer PENDING when event append fails') expects error.TransactionFailed from pollDueTimers() after a deliberately-seeded idempotency-key collision, but gets a normal zero-work result instead -- no error surfaced at all. Not yet root-caused (filed as a triage split from ISS-0184/GH-517's diagnosis pass, cluster C8). Possible explanations listed in the issue: poller silently swallows the forced DB error; collision setup isn't landing before pollDueTimers runs (commit-visibility/ordering issue); poller never attempts to fire the timer for an unrelated reason; for TC-SCH-02-02, the row-lock isn't held by whatever concurrent-locker helper the test uses, or the poller's SKIP LOCKED query isn't hitting the intended row. Read tests/integration/sch02_timer_polling_test.zig (both TC-SCH-02-02 and TC-SCH-02-03 blocks) and the scheduler's pollDueTimers implementation (search src/ for it) in full. Trace the actual locking and error-propagation logic -- this needs a real BACKEND-DEV-level trace, not surface-level speculation.
acceptance_criteria: TC-SCH-02-02 skip-locked-timer path traced: confirm whether the lock is actually held and whether the poller query correctly excludes locked rows
TC-SCH-02-03 forced-failure path traced: confirm whether the collision setup commits before polling, and whether pollDueTimers() correctly surfaces the underlying DB error
Root cause identified with file:line precision for both
